notes.title: Vote for Mimi at the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]

It's been a while since the release of Dordogne, and we're delighted with your feedback on Mimi's unique journey. From the bottom of our hearts, many thanks for your sharing and feedback. ❤️ 

[h2]Help us keep our beautiful Dordogne thriving![/h2]

Nominate us for the "Outstanding Visual Style" award 2023! Visual style doesn't aspire to real-world graphical fidelity (though a noble goal in itself)… it describes a distinctive look and feel that suffuses an entire game.

Immerse yourself in a [b]unique narrative experience[/b], embarking on [b]a vibrant journey[/b] that will [b]awaken your senses[/b] and [b]evoke warm memories[/b].

[b]Play as Mimi[/b], exploring the precious recollections of [b]your childhood[/b] and the times shared with your late grandmother. As past meets present, [b]confront your adult choices with fond childhood memories[/b] to [b]uncover lost family secrets[/b].

[b]Explore Dordogne landscapes[/b] of a thousand [b]summer colors[/b], within [b]sumptuous hand-painted watercolor environments[/b]. During your adventure, recall the moments, the panoramas, the scents, the sounds, and the sensations. [b]Recount these vivid memories in your journal[/b] as a recollection of Mimi’s family past that’s unique to your experience and a nostalgic, touching reflection of your journey.

[list]
[*] Explore the [b]stunning landscapes of Dordogne[/b] in hand-painted watercolors

notes.title: Chapter selection in Dordogne!
notes.content:
[h3]The wait is finally over... A brand new patch is now available on Dordogne, introducing [b]CHAPTER SELECTION![/b] 🎉

Whether you want to relive cherished moments or explore different paths, the power is in your hands 🌟[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/1b5d81118640e4a870bf94948bf39c5184da23f0.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Feature: Chapter Selection[/h1]

Due to popular demand, we have implemented a Chapter Selection feature! This option is now accessible once you've started a chapter and is easily available via a new button in the Main Menu.

To enhance this feature, we've included a summary per chapter, of the Collectibles you've amassed, visible in the newly established Chapter Select submenu.

Furthermore, [b]all cinematics[/b] you have previously viewed can be skipped when using the Chapter Select feature to improve the quality of life.

[b]One final and important note:[/b] This feature is compatible with [b]your past saves[/b], offering the freedom to revisit any part of the game, collect any missed Collectible and unlock any missed achievement/trophy without needing to restart the game!

[h2]General Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Corrected collider clipping occurring during kayaking.
[*] Resolved a critical bug causing Mimi to continuously walk in place while opening stores.
[*] Fixed issues related to sound triggers; some sounds were not playing at the correct time under certain circumstances.
[*] Resolved an inconsistency where memos and binder tasks were not updating properly.
[*] Corrected grammatical errors in texts.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Enhancements:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Included [b]Photosensitive[/b] and [b]Emotional trigger warnings[/b] at game launch for better player safety and awareness.
[*] Reworked specific animations to eliminate texture clipping.
[*] Improved world consistency by saving selected elements during Minigames and this can be seen later in the story.
[*] Enhanced performance in expansive scenery areas for a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience.
[/list]
 
[h3]We've heard your feedback and know how much this means to you all. We appreciate your patience and support!
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/

notes.title: Exciting patch for all Dordogne's players! 🍃
notes.content:
[h1]A brand-new patch is live now on PC, fixing major bugs and making your summer adventure with Mimi more peaceful! 🌼[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/2f6b6ebf548594ca39bd355648a9545397c2371b.jpg[/img]

Here’s what we worked on: 
[h2]
Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to clip through the ground when obtaining a collectible, ensuring a more consistent gameplay experience.
[*] Resolved a sound problem when changing the window focus during a cinematic, preventing audio disruptions.
[*] Overhauled various animations to enhance their quality, readability, and to eliminate instances of clipping, resulting in smoother visuals.
[*] Addressed multiple sound issues to ensure that all audio cues are played at the correct timing, enhancing overall immersion.
[*] Made changes to a shader to eliminate one-sided textures and improve depth of certain elements, enhancing visual fidelity.
[*] Fixed a critical issue that prevented camera clips from attaching and blocked player progress, ensuring a seamless gameplay flow.
[*] Improved and overhauled shaders and visual effects (VFX) for better overall quality and optimised framerate, enhancing visual experience.
[*] Rectified camera issues that occurred when leaving the game at specific moments, improving transitions and player control.
[*] Resolved language issues with Mimi, ensuring she now speaks exclusively in the language chosen in the options, without occasional English dialogue.
[*] Prevented Mimi from interacting with her surroundings while reading a Letter, using the Phone, or during a loading screen, reducing distractions.
[*] Improved texture quality on some objects.
[*] Implemented native support for the Steam Deck resolution in the options.
[*] Enhanced UI elements by adding mouse feedback, making it easier to identify interactive elements and improving overall usability.[/list]
[h2]
Quality of Life:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Enhanced mini games, such as breakfast and garden activities, by adding shadows under objects to improve spatial readability and provide a more immersive environment.
[*] Rearranged the order of collectibles in the Binder to align with their appearance sequence in each chapter, enhancing organisation and progression tracking.
[*] Added arrows around written and audio language options to indicate available choices. As a reminder, there are 14 written and 7 audio languages to choose from!
[*] Improved the user interface (UI) when reading Letters, enhancing readability, and making it more intuitive.
[*] Improved the Phone interface by allowing one to scroll through texts without spamming the down direction with the joystick.
[*] Addressed a previous issue that caused Phone conversations, especially with Fabrice, to end prematurely. This improvement further develops the relationship between Mimi and her father.
[*] Introduced additional interactive elements in the garden and Renaud's lair to enhance environmental storytelling and immersion.
[*] Increased font size to improve text readability, ensuring a more comfortable reading experience on small screens.
[*] Added Binder and Phone tasks to provide more explicit guidance to players and help them progress in the intended direction.
[/list]

notes.title: Discover the local myth behind Dordogne
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hi everyone, [/h3][/b]
Cédric Babouche here, I’m the art director behind Dordogne, a [b]heartfelt narrative adventure[/b] that takes you to Southern France, in the lovely Dordogne region! It’s an indie creation in [b]vibrant watercolors[/b], crafted by French studio [b]Un Je Ne Sais Quoi[/b], part of animation group [b]Umanimation[/b], and[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/] released on June 13[/url]!

[i]Dordogne [/i]tells the story of Mimi, a 32-year-old woman in search of her [b]childhood memories[/b] back in Dordogne, where she used to spend her summers with her grandmother. You will play as Mimi both as an adult and as a child, helping her [b]reconnect with her past[/b].

[b][h2]Help Renaud on his quest[/h2][/b]
To uncover and understand Mimi’s story, you’ll interact a lot with [b]Renaud[/b], another kid that she had befriended and used to play with. The main inspiration behind the character of Renaud is Huckleberry Finn, the animated series that I used to love watching during the 80s. Renaud is very intelligent, documented and resourceful. He learnt a great deal from Mimi's grandfather, who taught him in school. Sadly, he has a bad situation at home, with a violent dad. So, he spends his time outside. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/e0a9f34bf401c3833de5f1ef67ca6b7d83f24e3b.jpg[/img]

He is really an outcast and as such he spends a lot of time bonding with his [b]cat [/b]and [b]nature [/b]is his haven. It might seem cliché that he is dressed so simply, wears a bandage and has his head shaved, but his family is poor, he runs in the forest all the time hurting himself here and there, and when you catch head lice you get your head shaved. 
It was a reality of the time. And he has the reputation of a[b] thief [/b]in the surroundings, often getting caught at the market grabbing things because he is always looking for anything that can help him achieve his own little quest: to find a legendary creature called the [b]Coulobre[/b].

[h2][b]Hunt down the legendary Coulobre[/b][/h2]
Our team spent a lot of time in Dordogne to find [b]inspiration[/b], visiting places to find the nicest spots to take players to in the game, to paint them in watercolors, and, well, to let the region work its magic on all of us. And [b]the region does have a lot of magic in its local culture[/b]. 

I got my hands on a fascinating book in Castelnau – a town you’ll visit in the game – that tells all the myths and legends that make up the region’s lore. There were so many cool and intriguing things in there! We would have loved to include many more, but, considering the game’s scale, our Narrative Designer and I decided to focus solely on one myth: [b]the [/b][b]Coulobre[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/2aca06baec4654eba553a837cfaa2cea736d60e0.jpg[/img]

The Coulobre is the medieval legend of a monster – [b]a giant serpent[/b] – said to live in the Dordogne River and devour sailors. It is likely only a myth, as the Dordogne is not deep enough to host such a monster! But it was a way to explain why vessels and their crew would drown in the Dordogne. With all these drowned vessels, an immense treasure was believed to exist in the river. And that’s where Renaud comes in, trying to find the Coulobre and its treasure!


[b]So I hope you look forward to exploring Dordogne with Renaud and getting to know a bit of the magical side of the Dordogne Region. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/]Immerse yourself now in Mimi's childhood![/url][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/

notes.title: Dordogne – A nostalgic adventure
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi everyone, [/b][/h3]

Cédric Babouche here, artistic director at[b] Un Je Ne Sais Quoi[/b], the multimedia arm of French animation studio [b]Umanimation[/b], currently developing [i]Dordogne[/i], a narrative adventure that is coming June 13. It’s a heartfelt story about reminiscing your childhood memories, and I’m here to tell you a bit more about how the game takes you down memory lane!

[b][h2]Finding your past[/h2][/b]
In [i]Dordogne [/i]you play as Mimi, a 32-year-old woman traveling to Dordogne to visit the house of her recently deceased grandmother. They used to spend summers there together when Mimi was a child, but the last time was twenty years before. They have lost contact since and Mimi has no memories left from this time. As she rediscovers the house and its surroundings, some sights or objects become doors to the past and lost memories come rushing back to her.

Each key memory will act as a jump back in time where you play as 12-year-old Mimi on the last summer she spent at her grandmother’s. You’ll go back and forth between adult and child Mimi, until the memories you have recollected allow you to eventually find out what happened on that last summer in Dordogne.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/a4939cbf34d854f11c40082b18efe8942d958320.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Collect your own memories[/h2][/b]
To recollect a memory, you’ll have to complete mini games. Each of them offers a pretext to move forward in the story: they will allow you to get closer to your grandmother, to meet and start a friendship with a little boy named Renaud, to interact with people at Sarlat’s market…

The actions you will be performing will take you exploring your beautiful and peaceful surroundings to collect photos, sounds and words that you’ll put together in a binder. As you assemble your findings, the binder will read as a reminiscence of your Summertime as a child. 

Each player will take the photographs they want, choose the sounds and the words they want to collect, so you’ll really give life to your own binder and create your very own story to recall!

[b][h2]A game for the child in all of us[/h2][/b]
[i]Dordogne [/i]has a universal appeal in that it deals with that nostalgic, foggy relationship we all have with our childhood. We want it to be a game about a part of life that any person can relate to. There are things that every child has done, like bathing in a river, throwing pebbles, climbing rocks, running around in nature. [i]Dordogne [/i]is about these childhood moments.

But it is also about the human relations that shape our existence. We all have strong memories, good or bad, about important figures and interactions from when we were growing up. [i]Dordogne [/i]is also about these relationships that mark us—of which our team wanted to keep the best, most positive impression, the one that we all long for and that can resonate within every player! Our playtests have shown how much everyone can relate to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/6add03a7e9ce20332fa87cd6b5cc7088908a9cab.jpg[/img]

Depending on your story, you might get hooked instantly or it might take you a bit more time, but everyone found a little something that spoke to them and made them want to keep going with Mimi’s story!

[b][i]Dordogne [/i]came out on June 13, join us in this heart-warming experience [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/]here[/url]![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272840/Dordogne/

We are excited to announce a spring 2023 release window for the warm and colourful narrative adventure [b][i]Dordogne[/i][/b]! 

Dordogne is a heartfelt story of childhood memories, love, and family, to a picturesque pastoral backdrop in southern France. Immerse yourself in this poetic universe through our [b]Watercolor Memories Trailer[/b]!

[previewyoutube=3Klt73yr0MQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A new, French-infused creation comes to the indie world[/b]

Dordogne tells the story of Mimi, a young woman in search of her childhood memories that she has mysteriously forgotten. In [b]an idyllic French countryside setting hand-painted in vibrant pastel watercolors[/b], Mimi explores a world between childhood and adulthood, where one’s desires and regrets echo lost dreams and fears.[b] A nostalgic and heart-warming journey.
[/b]
Dordogne brings a homegrown taste of France as a wholesome experience which is sure to transport all types of players to a warm and peaceful place by the mighty Dordogne River. Artists from animation, film and video games work together to craft the sumptuous yet delicate aesthetic which makes it stand out, and everyone is super excited for the chance to show this very special piece to the world!

notes.title: Catch Dordogne on Twitch! 🖌
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]

Today, we are popping in to share an exciting announcement and something we’ve been working on behind closed doors for a while now: [b]Un Je Ne Sais Quoi is bringing Dordogne to Twitch![/b]

Tomorrow, [b]Friday 8th July[/b], will be our first ever livestream (on Twitch, YouTube and the Steam page) and we couldn’t be more excited. We’ve sorted the set-up and added some flair to our channel, so now all we have to do is go live!

Join us tomorrow from[b] 5pm CEST / 11am EDT[/b] where we’ll be sharing a live developer commentary over some watercolour painting for Dordogne - a perfect opportunity to learn more about our colourful adventure or ask any questions you have!

[h3][b]Follow us on [url=https://twitch.tv/studio_jnsq]Twitch [/url] [/b] 🎨[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37358611/2bd25f1387cb53199d6022a1036f08f8843f30f4.png[/img]
[h3]But what can you expect otherwise from studio_jnsq’s channel? [/h3]

Well, our Art Director, Cédric Babouche, will be hosting the streams – talking about his artistic process and all things Dordogne. He will also be sharing footage of his work on some of the gorgeous hand-painted watercolours that will be used within the game.

(Plus, we even have some live painting planned for future streams, which you won’t want to miss!) Overall, it will be a wholesome, relaxing, and art-filled time 🖌 

And that’s all, for now! 

We hope to see you in our live tomorrow, either on Twitch or here, and we can’t wait to chat  ☕️

Much love from France,

Un Je Ne Sais Quoi
